interface.signature: def canMeasureWater(x: int, y: int, z: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: Capacities and target volume must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (z == 0 or (x + y >= z and z % math.gcd(x, y) == 0))
postconditions.description: It is possible to measure exactly z litres if z is zero or if the sum of the capacities is at least z and z is a multiple of the greatest common divisor of x and y.
